metadata.directory: National Skills Register & MDEC Digital Skills Directory Malaysia
metadata.accreditation: HRD Corp Claimable / MDEC Certified / Global Accredited (edX, Coursera)

courses.title: Corporate GHG Accounting & Scope 3 Value Chain Certification
courses.provider: HRD Corp Claimable / Malaysian Green Technology and Climate Change Corporation (MGTC)
courses.description: Standardized ISO 14064 & GHG Protocol Scope 3 calculation methodologies, supplier carbon data gathering, and Bursa Malaysia compliance frameworks.

courses.title: TinyML: Practical Deep Learning on Microcontrollers
courses.description: Deploying quantized TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers models on ARM Cortex-M hardware for vibration, acoustic, and thermal anomaly detection.

courses.title: Industrial IoT & LoRaWAN Sensor Network Deployment
courses.provider: MDEC Digital Skills Directory / MIMOS Berhad
courses.description: Configuring gateways, Modbus to LoRaWAN transceivers, payload decoders, and secure telemetry ingestion into cloud and edge dashboards.

courses.title: High-Voltage Electric Vehicle Safety & Battery Diagnostics (Level 3)
courses.provider: HRD Corp Claimable / Malaysia Automotive, Robotics & IoT Institute (MARii)
courses.description: NFPA 70E certified high-voltage isolation, CAN bus diagnostics, battery cell balancing, and emergency post-accident battery triage.

courses.title: Agentic Workflows & Automated SQL Data Systems
courses.description: Building self-evaluating agentic chains, zero-shot structured database queries, document parsing, and financial ledger anomaly detection.

courses.title: CAAM Drone Remote Pilot License (RPL) & Telemetry Navigation
courses.provider: HRD Corp Claimable / Drone Academy Asia (CAAM ATO Approved)
courses.description: Official CAAM drone pilot licensing, RTK autonomous mission planning, airspace regulations, and agricultural spray flight execution.

courses.title: Agricultural Computer Vision & Multispectral NDVI Analytics
courses.description: Multispectral orthomosaics, vegetation indices (NDVI, NDRE), crop canopy nitrogen deficiency models, and soil moisture sensor fusion.

courses.title: Bursa Malaysia ESG Reporting & Bank Negara CCPT Compliance
courses.provider: HRD Corp Claimable / Institute of Corporate Directors Malaysia (ICDM)
courses.description: Applying Bursa Malaysia Sustainability Reporting Guide and BNM Climate Change and Principle-based Taxonomy (CCPT) to corporate balance sheets.

courses.title: Robot Operating System (ROS 2) for Industrial Cobots
courses.provider: MDEC Digital Skills Directory / Robopreneur Academy
courses.description: ROS 2 Humble / Iron architecture, robotic arm inverse kinematics, MoveIt motion planning, and cleanroom automation safety barriers.

courses.title: Energy-Optimal Automation & Factory Cleanroom Kinematics
courses.description: Reducing peak kilowatt load in automated assembly lines, regenerative drive optimization, and optical sorting of electronic scrap.

courses.title: Renewable Energy SCADA & Battery Energy Storage Dispatch
courses.provider: HRD Corp Claimable / Sustainable Energy Development Authority (SEDA)
courses.description: Supervisory control and data acquisition for solar PV farms, lithium-ion BESS grid peak-shaving, and frequency droop stabilization.

courses.title: Ethical Workplace Mediation & Multi-Stakeholder Dialogue
courses.provider: Malaysian Institute of Arbitrators & HRD Corp Claimable
courses.description: Conflict de-escalation, managing supplier just-transition anxieties, interviewing vulnerable workers, and multi-vendor dispute resolution.

courses.title: Forensic Accounting, Fraud Investigation & Anomaly Detection
courses.provider: Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) & Coursera
courses.description: Investigating false invoicing, ESG greenwashing claims, whistleblower triage, and Benford's Law anomaly testing on general ledgers.

courses.title: Circular Economy & Material Flow Analysis (MFA) with Python
courses.description: Sankey diagrams for material flow accounting, zero-landfill manufacturing modeling, digital product passports, and polymer recycling streams.

courses.title: Machine Learning for Solar & Wind Power Forecasting
courses.provider: Imperial College London & edX (Free Audit available)
courses.description: Neural time-series forecasting, LSTM and transformer architectures for solar cloud passage prediction and grid ancillary services.
